question:
Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Latent
solution: The correct answer is **"Obvious."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Latent"** means hidden or inactive. (विद्यमान परंतु प्रकट या सक्रिय नहीं; प्रच्‍छन्‍न) • **Example**: *She has a **latent**__ disease.* • **"Obvious"** is the correct antonym of **"Latent."** • **"Obvious"** means easily noticeable or apparent. (जो आसानी से दिखाई दे या समझ में आए; स्‍पष्‍ट) __ • **Example**: *For **obvious**__ reasons, I’d prefer not to give my name.* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Deceitful"** means dishonest or misleading. (कपटी; बहकाने वाला) • **"Casual"** means relaxed or informal. (तनावमुक्त और अचिंतित; प्रयास, परवाह या रुचि से वंचित) • **"Dormant"** means temporarily inactive or asleep. (कुछ समय के लिए निष्क्रिय) 32:Tbf7, The correct answer is **"Saline."**
